entries.title: Psalms 49:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> Hear this, all [ye] people; give ear, all [ye] inhabitants of the world: {for: or, of}

entries.title: Psalms 49:2
segments: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

entries.title: Psalms 49:3
segments: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart [shall be] of understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 49:4
segments: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 49:5
segments: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

entries.title: Psalms 49:6
segments: ¶They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

entries.title: Psalms 49:7
segments: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

entries.title: Psalms 49:8
segments: (For the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

entries.title: Psalms 49:9
segments: That he should still live for ever, [and] not see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 49:10
segments: For he seeth [that] wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

entries.title: Psalms 49:11
segments: Their inward thought [is, that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [and] their dwelling places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names. {all...: Heb. generation and generation}

entries.title: Psalms 49:12
segments: Nevertheless man [being] in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts [that] perish.

entries.title: Psalms 49:13
segments: This their way [is] their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah. {approve...: Heb. delight in their mouth}

entries.title: Psalms 49:14
segments: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling. {beauty: or, strength} {in the grave from...: or, the grave being an habitation to every one of them}

words.text: . {beauty: or, strength} {in the grave from...: or, the grave being an habitation to every one of them}

entries.title: Psalms 49:15
segments: ¶But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah. {power: Heb. hand} {the grave: or, hell}

entries.title: Psalms 49:16
segments: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

entries.title: Psalms 49:17
segments: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

entries.title: Psalms 49:18
segments: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and [men] will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself. {while...: Heb. in his life}

words.text: to thyself. {while...: Heb. in his life}

entries.title: Psalms 49:19
segments: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light. {He...: Heb. The soul shall}

entries.title: Psalms 49:20
segments: Man [that is] in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts [that] perish.
